name: systemd-user-unit-persistence
description: Practice-box persistence finding: installs a systemd --user unit for a named user and (by default) turns on linger for them, so the user manager -- and the unit -- start at boot with no login. Vars: USERNAME (required, must already exist), UNIT_NAME (required, no .service suffix), EXEC_START (required), DESCRIPTION (optional), LINGER (optional, default 1), PAYLOAD_PATH + PAYLOAD_BODY (optional).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu


: "${USERNAME:?USERNAME is required}"
: "${UNIT_NAME:?UNIT_NAME is required (no .service suffix)}"
: "${EXEC_START:?EXEC_START is required}"

if [ -n "${PAYLOAD_PATH-}" ]; then
    install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname -- "$PAYLOAD_PATH")"
    printf '#!/bin/sh\n%s\n' "${PAYLOAD_BODY-}" > "$PAYLOAD_PATH"
    chmod 0755 "$PAYLOAD_PATH"
fi

home=$(getent passwd "$USERNAME" | cut -d: -f6)
if [ -z "$home" ]; then
    echo "systemd-user-unit-persistence: user $USERNAME not found" >&2
    exit 1
fi

ud="$home/.config/systemd/user"
install -d -m 0755 "$ud"
{
    printf '%s\n' '[Unit]'
    printf 'Description=%s\n' "${DESCRIPTION:-User service}"
    printf '\n%s\n' '[Service]'
    printf '%s\n' 'Type=simple'
    printf 'ExecStart=%s\n' "$EXEC_START"
    printf '\n%s\n' '[Install]'
    printf '%s\n' 'WantedBy=default.target'
} > "$ud/${UNIT_NAME}.service"
chown "$USERNAME" "$ud/${UNIT_NAME}.service" 2>/dev/null || :

if [ "${LINGER:-1}" = "1" ] && command -v loginctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    loginctl enable-linger "$USERNAME" 2>/dev/null || :
fi
